meanings.note: Core Russian adv meaning 'together' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: And Osipenko is lying at home right now. He has a sick heart.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'казать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to order', paired with 'заказывать'.

examples.text: Если опоздают, пицца бесплатно. Может, закажем?

meanings.en: to lure, to entice into a trap

meanings.en: to interrupt, to break off, to cut short
meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to interrupt, to cut short', paired with 'прерывать'.

examples.trans: Just one more second! You interrupted such a dream of mine!

meanings.note: Prefix 'раз-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'огреть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to warm up, to melt', paired with 'разогревать'.

examples.trans: The chocolate needs to be melted.
How much chocolate needs to be melted?

meanings.note: The г sounds like в. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'егодня').
